summary.scoring: WAPE = sum|a - f| / sum a, bias = sum(f - a) / sum a, against the final unconstrained demand; cells with unknown demand are not scored

ladder.label: Oracle: in-hindsight level (noise floor, not a forecast)

leakage_check.rule: an honest forecast must score above the in-hindsight oracle of the same scoring set; tests/test_model_leakage.py checks that altering data after an origin leaves that origin's forecasts unchanged

summary.why: the equal-weight ensemble with the GBM improved WAPE + |bias| in only 1 of 4 folds (rule: at least 3), so the structural model ships alone

ensemble.rule: keep a member only if it improves WAPE + |bias| in at least 3 of 4 folds
